author: Unreal Engine
description:
In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, Riot Games walks through the different stages of optimization used in '2XKO', their free-to-play fighting game built on Unreal Engine 5. 

The talk explores the technical challenges involved in delivering high-fidelity stylized visuals while hitting strict CPU and GPU budgets on low-end devices. Riot walks through real-world production case studies to show what can be bottleneck performance, how to find where the problems are, and how to fix them using Unreal Engine’s tools. 

Watch to learn practical strategies to enforce best practices and ensure their games run efficiently across a wide range of devices. The presentation goes into the collaborative stage optimization workflow used by artists, technical artists, and engineers to balance visual fidelity with strict framerate targets.

title: Fighting the Frame Budget: Stage Optimization Lessons from 2XKO | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, Brown Bag Films tells the story of what happens when a studio goes all in. 

They share the practical, hard-won insights of running six concurrent animated productions entirely in Unreal Engine, from layout through final render, using version 5.7 and a fully in-engine keyframe animation pipeline, partnering with clients such as Disney and Netflix. 

Brown Bag talks about how they’ve moved beyond experimentation: With well over 100 animators working natively in Unreal Engine across multiple sites on a wide range of characters, they've matured a pipeline that not only scales globally but embraces the demand of high-end linear content. 

The team walks through real-world production shots and working examples to show how they integrated recent engine updates with studio-developed tools to solve common blockers in real-time character animation workflows.

Find out more about using Unreal Engine for animation here: unrealengine.com/uses/
title: All in on UE: What Happens When 100 Animators Stop Round-Tripping | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
